title: Hoshino Ichika — Nervous Message Of Thanks〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'm almost finished with my homework... I think I'll take a quick break and see how our videos are doing.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh...
The video of us has gotten a few more views.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So many people have been listening to our song...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Including people who don't know us or who live in areas too far away for us to perform in yet...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I hope that someday we'll be able to move the hearts of a huge number of people with our music...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I should see how the video with Miku singing is doing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's see... Wow, this one's gotten even more views!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think I have Kanade to thank for this one as well.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, speaking of which...
We've been so busy that I haven't had a chance to tell her anything about what's happened.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (As much as I'd like to tell her in person, it doesn't seem right for me to ask to go over to her house again. For now, I'll just send her a message...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Umm...
<Pardon me. I know this is very sudden.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We have a group chat with Minori and the others in it, so I should be a little more informal...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Um...
<Long time no see.>
No, it hasn't actually been that long...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
<Hello. How are you doing?>
No, still doesn't sound right...
What if I just said, “Good evening?”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
<Good evening. I posted that song we discussed the other day!>
Wait, the exclamation point seems unnecessary. How about an emoji instead...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I know. I should paste the video links. The one with our band and the one with Miku... Also...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
There...
It looks a little longer than I was expecting, but I think I managed to say everything that I wanted to...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Now I'm getting anxious...
For now, I should go back to finishing my homework.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (She's probably focused on writing a song right now.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Which could mean that she won't see my message until tomorrow...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I should rest early tonight so I'm ready for practice tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Message from Kanade
rows.Line: <Sorry, I have trouble typing messages on my phone and>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. She replied using stamps in our group chat that other time... Is it because she's not used to typing out messages on her phone?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, an otter stamp...
Hehe. It's saying, “Thank you.”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Minori showed these stamps to us, didn't she? These otters are making such funny facial expressions... And to think that Kanade's using them...)

rows.Speaker: Message from Kanade
rows.Line: <I think I'm getting the hang of typing on my phone.>

rows.Speaker: Message from Kanade
rows.Line: <I saw the videos, and listened to your band's performance. I liked the way you all played, and the song is good, so it should keep getting more views.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
<I really appreciate it.
It's all thanks to the advice you gave me, Kanade.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
<I hope we get another chance to work together like that. But for now, good night.>
Oh, I'll toss in a stamp too...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. We sent each other the same “good night” stamp...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm so glad that I finally got to tell her...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami was asking about which flowers to bring the next time she goes over to Kanade's house.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think I'll look some up before I go to bed. Let's see... The ones she took over last time were...
